name: The Shadow Syndicate
storyline:
The Great War is over. The gangsters run the streets. The jazz is loud. But something darker than crime is creeping through the alleys. People are disappearing. Strange symbols show up on the walls. And a private detective named Sam Marlowe just took a case that might cost him more than his life.

Step into the shoes of Sam Marlowe, a retired soldier turned private detective, as he unravels a city-wide conspiracy involving secret societies, occult forces, and a creeping darkness threatening to consume it all.

Drawn into the mystery, Sam reluctantly teams up with Elo, the spirited daughter of the city’s mayor. Together, they begin to uncover a far reaching conspiracy that implicates a shadowy organization. As Sam and Elo race against time, they must navigate a web of betrayal, expose the Syndicate’s sinister agenda, and ultimately stop a malevolent force from consuming the very soul of Brooklyn.
summary: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.
